items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: He played with us at the, at the Entenus Cafe.

ctx.x: I suppose that was often a piano feature.

Yes, a piano, when we got kind of tired playing, we stopped him at the piano and played a couple of choruses, and he liked it. And incidentally, did you hear about Everett Robbins? He played with us at the, at the Entenus Cafe. No. He died of consumption. Oh. Everett Robbins. He made one or two rags.
Oh, yes, of course, of course. I have a picture of him. Unfortunately, he isn't here, but he joined Rice up in Milwaukee.
